# Card services
## Lost or stolen cards
Report a lost or stolen debit or credit card immediately through the app, online banking or the 24-hour helpline. The card is blocked at once and cannot be unblocked.
## Replacement cards
A replacement card is dispatched within two working days and arrives within five working days at the registered address. There is no fee for the first replacement in a year.
## Card PIN
A forgotten PIN can be reset in the app. A new PIN mailer is posted on request.
